text:
Omar: Quick poll for the weekend lunch club: Ramen, Pizza, or Big Salad? Vote with emoji and drop any special requests. :yum:
Kayla: Options: :one: Ramen :two: Pizza :three: Big Salad. Also open to combo orders.
ops-bot: Poll started: 1) Ramen 2) Pizza 3) Big Salad 1 react to cast your vote. Closing in 45m.
Diego: :two: Pizza for me. Thin crust, extra basil pls.
Sophie: :one: Ramen. Tonkotsu energy. Also can we get soft boiled eggs?
Liam: :three: Big Salad 1 trying to be healthy but will happily steal fries.
Kayla: Also shout if anyone needs GF or vegan options so we can split appropriately.
Omar: Fun twist: if ramen wins Ill bring chopsticks from home. If pizza wins I'll supply hot sauce packets. If salad wins someone brings dressing.
Diego: Hot sauce packets = strong incentive.
Sophie: I will cry if no egg. Also I can bring extra chili oil.
ops-bot: Interim tally 1 Ramen: 1, Pizza: 1, Big Salad: 1. Still open.
Liam: Could we do pizza + salad split and call it a day? Asking for balance.
Kayla: Compromise is allowed but this is a democratic poll.
Omar: Closing in 10m. Thanks for the quick votes!
ops-bot: Poll closed. Final tally: Ramen 2, Pizza 2, Big Salad 1. Winners: Ramen & Pizza (tie).
Omar: Tie means split order! Ramen for the ramen-lovers, pizza for the pizza-lovers. Liam you still want salad?
Liam: I'll order a salad for myself and chip in.
Diego: I'll bring basil and hot sauce.
Sophie: Eggs and chili oil on ramen side.
Kayla: I'll coordinate the split and send payment link.
Omar: Thanks team! Meetup at 12:20 outside the kitchen. :raised_hands:
